items.rationale: Every time decision resolves through the authority. TimeAuthority::now_impl/convert_impl enforce declared-domain lookup (UnknownClock), host-source nullopt (ClockSourceFailure), bounds (ClockOutOfBounds), monotonic regression (ClockRegression), checked signed addition via __builtin_add_overflow (ClockOverflow), missing mapping (MissingMapping), and full-range unsigned distance against the destination reading (ToleranceExceeded). SessionManager::transition resolves the same-domain path through now_impl and the cross-domain path through convert_impl, so no raw cross-domain timestamp is ever compared (SR-005, ADV-R1a..d).

items.rationale: SessionManager::consume validates the full envelope field-by-field (first_mismatch over all twelve FieldLocator values) before any consumption, then performs read-only replay probes (session identity first, then permit identity) before live-session slot allocation, then the atomic PermitRegistry::try_consume check-then-insert only after a slot is available. This realizes the F-IMP-01 repair (replay precedence over capacity, transactional capacity rejection) and the quota/action validation happens in transition before any mutation (apply decrements only after all checks).

items.rationale: The constexpr transition_outcome/successor_state table covers every (state, action) pair: legal forward transitions, safe AlreadyApplied repeats (producing_action match), terminal lockout (TerminalState for non-producing action from a terminal state), and InvalidTransition otherwise; header static_asserts pin the key outcomes. ValidationSession::apply returns Ok/AlreadyApplied/InvalidTransition/TerminalState/QuotaExhausted and mutates state and quota only on Ok. All eight states are reachable and every terminal state admits no outgoing transition.

items.rationale: SessionManager::locate_locked validates scope first (ForeignHandle for a different/recreated manager scope), then controller registration, superseded window (RecreatedController), generation (StaleHandle when older, InvalidHandle when newer), and session-id presence (SessionNotFound). A foreign controller whose session id matches a live session is ForeignHandle; an otherwise unknown quadruple is InvalidHandle. None of these paths addresses or mutates a live session.

items.rationale: TimeAuthority, PermitRegistry, and SessionManager are non-copyable and non-movable (deleted special members) and each is guarded by one std::mutex, matching design §9.1; header static_asserts enforce non-copyability/non-movability and Permit/Diagnostic value-copyability. Lifetime is documented (destroy before threads exit).

items.rationale: Diagnostic is a bounded std::array<Result,8> plus one optional<std::uint32_t> locator; static_asserts enforce payload-freedom (not constructible from string_view; sizeof <= 128). from_first selects the lowest precedence_rank, accumulate sorts by rank and caps at capacity 8, and precedence is the Result enum declaration order (handle failures before context/time/action/permit/quota/capacity). Every rejected consume/transition writes only the diagnostic and leaves session/registry/authority state unchanged (NOMUT-* snapshot-equality tests).
